title: Loading an FBX File with Embedded Textures
description: Loads a binary Autodesk FBX file whose diffuse texture is embedded inline (carried as a Video node's Content bytes rather than referenced as an external file), and views it. FBXLoader decodes the embedded image, creates a SceneModel texture, and wires it to each material. The sample is four cubes sharing one geometry and one embedded checkerboard texture, each cube tinted by its own material colour.
